_note: Provenance for every logo hosted here. Most come from Wikimedia Commons and are tagged public domain there, because a mark made only of type and simple shapes falls below the threshold of originality and carries no copyright; those are the entries with a Commons page. The rest were published by the org itself in a press kit, or supplied directly. Five files (ROC Esports, Rule One, Elevate, Chiefs Esports Club, Limitless) came via Liquipedia, which hosts them under its own fair-use claim rather than a licence; those entries say so, and they are the first to pull if anyone objects. Commons files are the black-on-transparent variants recoloured white for a dark background, shape unchanged; press-kit and supplied files are used as published. The trademark always remains the org's: these appear only to identify the team whose players are listed, and imply no endorsement. Orgs whose mark is original artwork and who have not published a kit keep generated initials instead.

lil-step-bros.note: A player-run team rather than an org. File supplied directly; background keyed to transparent, no other change.

spacestation-gaming.note: Published by Spacestation Gaming on their own press kit page, which states no usage restrictions. Used as published, resized only. Brand contact: info@spacestation.com.

team-bsk.note: bsk agreed to the use of their mark on 2026-09-07. Cropped to the crest's own circular edge and keyed to transparent outside it; colours reduced to 32, shape unchanged.

wildcard.note: Artwork taken from the org's own website, which publishes this mark as an SVG. The wordmark half of the lockup was dropped and only the crest kept; colours, shapes and proportions are unchanged. Shipped as SVG rather than PNG because the source is vector.
